newsitem.title: USA: Reuters 3000 svcs to receive GovPX pricing.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 3000 svcs to receive GovPX pricing.

text.p: Reuters America Holdings Inc, a subsidiary of Reuters Holdings Plc, on Monday said GovPX has agreed to provide daily and historical pricing on U.S. Treasuries to subscribers of Reuters fixed income products and new Treasury 3000 services.

GovPX, which provides real-time prices and volume on U.S. Treasury securities, will immediately begin downloading end-of-day pricing for all active and off-the-run Treasuries to Reuters fixed income database.

Subscribers to Reuters new Markets 3000 and Treasury 3000 services will be able to retrieve GovPX end-of-day prices as of 1500 EDT/1900 GMT and 1600 EDT/2000 GMT at no additional cost. Additionally, subscribers will have access to three years of GovPX daily closing prices for all active and off-the-run U.S. Treasuries via Reuters fixed income database.
